create.name: Selena Lael
create.bio:
Selena Lael is a Florida-based yoga and meditation teacher whose work is built around self-love as a path to inner freedom. She trained at the National Holistic Institute in California, finishing in 2004, and went on to qualify as an experienced registered yoga teacher (E-RYT), a yoga nidra instructor and a life coach. Since 2001 she has been a student of the spiritual teacher Her Holiness Sai Maa, and that devotional training shapes the warmth and sense of service in her classes.

Her sessions weave together guided meditation, breath practice, yoga nidra, affirmations and gentle body-based techniques, with an emphasis on forgiveness, compassion and coming home to the heart. She has taught yoga and mindfulness to individuals and to companies for many years, and she offers one-to-one coaching online. Each year she leads small residential retreats abroad, currently in Costa Rica and in Kerala, India, where daily yoga and meditation sit alongside rest and time in nature. On Insight Timer she shares free meditations, live community sessions and two multi-day courses, and on DailyOM she teaches a ten-lesson course on softening the inner critic.

videos.title: Awaken My Heart ~ Self Love Series: The Power of the Mind & Affirmations

courses.title: The Joy of Life | Costa Rica
courses.description: A week-long residential retreat at Anamaya on Costa Rica's Pacific coast, with daily yoga and meditation, time for rest and a small group of up to eighteen. Rooms range from a shared women's dorm to private doubles.

courses.title: Rejuvenation Retreat | India
courses.description: A week in Kerala that pairs her daily yoga and meditation sessions with an introduction to Ayurveda and a seaside setting. Places are by application, with several room types to choose from.

courses.title: 1:1 Coaching with Selena Lael
courses.description: Private online sessions that draw on her coaching training together with meditation, breath and body awareness, centred on self-love and inner steadiness. Enquiries go through her contact form.

courses.title: Awaken My Heart: A Guide to Living with Self-Love
courses.description: An eleven-day Insight Timer course on learning to treat yourself with more kindness, taken one short session a day.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Yogic Practices For A Peaceful Life
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course of short yogic practices, one a day, meant to bring more calm and steadiness into everyday life.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Breaking the Mental Loops of Negative Self-Talk
courses.description: A self-paced ten-lesson course on DailyOM using written, audio and video lessons. Each day looks at where harsh inner talk comes from and offers one mind-body practice to answer it with compassion.
courses.price: Pay what you want (from $22 USD, suggested $33 USD)

free_resources.title: Selena Lael on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations, yoga nidra and affirmation practices, plus her regular live Return to Love sessions in the app.

free_resources.title: Return to Love | Free Online Event Replay
free_resources.description: The recording of an hour-long free online gathering she led, with talk, meditation and reflection on self-love and the heart.
